artikel.titel: FX Daily: Korean won stands out in a harsh EM environment
artikel.text: It looks like the sell-off in risk assets has run its course for now, with investors starting to find value in equities, commodities and some FX pairs. How long this calm lasts is unknown, since it looks like the Fed will have to push ahead with tightening. To withstand dollar strength, currencies will need a good story. The Korean won has one

artikel.titel: German consumers still don’t share companies’ optimism
artikel.text: EUROPE: While leading business sentiment indicators like the Ifo index and the PMI point to a continuation of the cyclical rebound of the German economy, consumers' wallets remain closed

artikel.titel: Rates Spark: No risk appetite for Thanksgiving dinner
artikel.text: Despite another hot US inflation reading, rates are under downward pressure amid fragile risk sentiment. Growing concerns about growth could push down the belly of the euro curve as they did in 2008 and 2023. Meanwhile, the ECB will likely wait until 2027 to evaluate minimum reserve requirements

artikel.titel: Strong growth and elevated inflation signal more Fed tightening
artikel.text: NORTH AMERICA: Solid growth, decent jobs and elevated inflation all point to the need for further policy tightening from the Federal Reserve. Nonetheless, the plunge in commodity prices and the weak wage growth environment suggest the Fed doesn't need to move aggressively

artikel.titel: The US tariff wall keeps changing, but it isn’t coming down
artikel.text: TRADE: The US is preparing another round of tariffs, this time targeting structural overcapacity across 16 trading partners. It is another reminder that while the legal justification for tariffs keeps changing, US protectionism is becoming increasingly difficult to unwind

artikel.titel: Australia’s CPI surprise keeps RBA on alert, but weak growth signals argue for patience
artikel.text: AUSTRALIA: Australia's October CPI rose to 4.9% year-on-year, driven by higher transport and electricity prices, with broader pass-through to core inflation. Despite the upside inflation surprise, falling oil prices and a weakening labour market should allow the Reserve Bank to keep rates unchanged as growth slows into 2027

artikel.titel: The Commodities Feed: Oil shrugs off rising Middle East tensions
artikel.text: Oil prices moved lower this morning despite further attacks around the Strait of Hormuz, with recovering Gulf exports and a sharp loosening in the Dubai crude curve signalling a more comfortable supply picture

artikel.titel: FX Daily: Full EMFX unwind underway
artikel.text: The investment environment remains hostile. Lingering uncertainty over the US tech story, Fed tightening and now a little more tariff uncertainty are leading to a full unwind of risk-seeking trades, particularly in EMFX. More pressure could come today with hot core US PCE inflation. Expect EMFX and commodity FX to remain on the back foot

artikel.titel: German economic rebound lost steam in the third quarter
artikel.text: EUROPE: After the optimism around Germany’s economic resilience in the first half of the year, this morning’s data suggest the recovery is losing steam again

artikel.titel: Rates Spark: Treasuries with blinkers on
artikel.text: We had a solid (post-midterms) consumer sentiment report on Tuesday – ignored by Treasuries. We had the Nvidia reversal on Monday – ignored by Treasuries. Wednesday sees a PCE inflation report that won't be pretty – should be tough for Treasuries to ignore. Or, maybe Treasures are just in a good Thanksgiving mood. Still looks a tad too rosy
